tasks.migration_objective: Move canonical invoice signatures from RSA-PSS to ML-DSA-65.
preconditions: InvoiceSeal tests pass.
Invoice records and identities are synthetic.
expected_behavior: Preserve the signed invoice fields and version semantics.
Reject modified messages, wrong verification keys, and malformed public-key encodings.
migration_requirements: Use the pinned standardized ML-DSA API with invoice-specific context.
Update public-key format consumers and signature persistence.
Do not silently fall back to RSA.
verification_procedure: Run original and migrated test modules separately.
Exercise positive verification, tamper/wrong-key rejection, serialization, revision identity, and database history.
known_limitations: Candidate only until integration review.
Historical signatures attest to their recorded revision, not the current invoice.
